items.title: Morning Blessings Sunflower Tea Set
items.alt: A yellow sunflower teapot and cup sit beside a blue flower jug above a “MORNING BLESSINGS” ribbon.
items.description: Small blue flowers decorate the lid and banner, linking the warm tea set to the tall sunflower arrangement.

items.title: Birthday Blessings Lavender Cake
items.alt: Gold “BIRTHDAY BLESSINGS” lettering rises above a lavender cake with three lit candles and white flowers.
items.description: Pearled icing swags and an ornate gold pedestal give the small celebration cake a formal, decorative silhouette.

items.title: Anniversary Blessings Rings and Lilies
items.alt: Two interlinked gold rings rest on an ivory ribbon between white calla lilies beneath “ANNIVERSARY BLESSINGS” lettering.
items.description: Fine gold edges on the curled ribbon echo the raised serif text, while green leaves separate the white flower shapes.

items.title: New Baby Blessings Wicker Cradle
items.alt: A wicker cradle with a cream knitted blanket and blue bow stands beside tiny booties under a “NEW BABY BLESSINGS” banner.
items.description: Golden stars follow the curved cream-and-blue ribbon above the empty, softly lined basket.

items.title: Wedding Blessings Dove and Peonies
items.alt: A white dove with spread wings carries a cream “WEDDING BLESSINGS” ribbon above a pink peony bouquet.
items.description: Layered wing feathers and flowing ivory ribbon tails frame the rose-and-cream flowers and muted green leaves.

items.title: Travel Blessings Vintage Suitcase
items.alt: A teal suitcase with brass corners and brown straps stands beneath a “TRAVEL BLESSINGS” banner beside a blank blue booklet.
items.description: Two luggage tags show a green sprig and yellow sun beside the case’s brown straps, brass-colored corner guards and plain navy booklet.
